title: Add neon glow effect and custom font styling to nav branding and accent elements

requirements.text: Enhance the 'NFS MODS HUB' text in the navigation bar (`frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx`) with a neon glow effect using CSS text-shadow with the neon accent color (#C8FF00). Ensure the Barlow Condensed bold typeface is applied. Optionally add a subtle pulsing or static glow animation to make the branding visually striking.

quotes: Adding a neon glow effect and custom font styling to the 'NFS MODS HUB' text and key accent elements to make them really pop!

acceptanceCriteria: The 'NFS MODS HUB' nav text displays a visible neon glow effect using #C8FF00 or equivalent CSS variable
The Barlow Condensed bold typeface is applied to the nav branding text
The glow effect is consistent with the dark racing theme and does not interfere with readability

requirements.text: Apply neon glow styling to other key accent elements across the site (e.g., the 'Upload Mod' button, active nav links, download buttons, category badges, and card hover borders) using CSS box-shadow or text-shadow with the neon accent color (#C8FF00). Define reusable Tailwind utility classes or CSS custom properties for neon glow effects in `frontend/src/index.css` or `frontend/tailwind.config.js` so the effect is applied consistently.

quotes: Adding a neon glow effect and custom font styling to the 'NFS MODS HUB' text and key accent elements to make them really pop!

acceptanceCriteria: Neon glow effects are applied to primary CTA buttons (Upload Mod, Download, Login)
Card hover borders emit a neon glow effect consistent with the accent color
Active or hovered nav links show a neon glow or underline accent
Glow utility classes are defined in a reusable way (Tailwind config or CSS variables)
The effects are consistent across all pages and do not cause layout shifts

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All neon glow effects must use the existing #C8FF00 accent color or its CSS variable equivalent
nonGoals: Changing the site color scheme or overall theme direction
